close_reason: Merged into KITH-q7et.58 (same finding: Identity needs impl Display)
description:
kith-core/src/auth.rs:32: Identity has pub fn display(&self) -> &str which implements the "best available name" fallback logic. This is a user-visible representation but it is not impl std::fmt::Display.

As a result, callers cannot use format!("{identity}") or write!(f, "{identity}") — they must call identity.display() explicitly, which is easy to forget and non-idiomatic.

Fix: implement std::fmt::Display for Identity, delegating to the display() fallback logic. The existing display() method can be deprecated and removed, or kept as an internal helper if the &str return type is needed in some hot path.

Note: the kith-core crate is a foundational library used by all other crates; fixing Display here will simplify logging and error formatting throughout the workspace.
title: Identity::display() should be impl Display, not a method
